title: World View V1 Built-in Field Descriptor Registry
status: recommended V1 seed registry; adopted Field Dataset ownership contract; not a frozen ADR
authority: Core Domain static Field Descriptor Registry

common_rules.identity: A stable field_key identifies one semantic field role within a Map; it is not a filename, tile ID, Object ID or derived artifact ID.
common_rules.ownership: Each Field Dataset is owned by exactly one Map. V1 permits one authoritative Dataset per (map_id, field_key).
common_rules.revision: Published Field Revisions are immutable, monotonically numbered within their Dataset, and reference immutable Core Assets through typed Field Revision ownership.
common_rules.current_pointer: The Dataset current revision pointer must reference a revision belonging to that same Dataset and advances with expected-current-revision compare-and-swap.
common_rules.temporal_scope: Map Source Field Baseline. A new current revision applies retroactively to every Branch and every Historical Time point of the owning Map. Historical Time does not select an older Field Revision in V1.
common_rules.map_isolation: A revision update affects only its owning Map. Identical content-addressed Asset bytes may be reused by another Map, but Dataset identity and current pointers remain independent.
common_rules.history_boundary: Field Dataset creation and revision publication are not Commands, Events or State Changes. V1 has no Branch-local overrides or time-varying field history.
common_rules.staging: Editor and AI may stage and preview content. Only Core Domain Field Dataset Domain Services may publish formal Dataset/Revision records.
common_rules.immutable_payload: Published Asset bytes are immutable. Updates publish new Asset content and a new Field Revision; never overwrite a published payload.
common_rules.manifest: Every new formal revision uses Manifest V2: it pins Map/Map Space, immutable Spatial Reference and its coordinate_precision_profile_id, coverage, map-edge semantics, resolution (spacing_x/spacing_y plus width/height), grid alignment (origin_x/origin_y, axis_orientation and cell_registration), value type, dimensional units, vertical reference where required, no-data, sample encoding, tile manifest where applicable, provenance and content fingerprint. Manifest V1 is legacy-read-only.
common_rules.derived_adoption: A Derived Artifact is not a source Field Dataset unless the creator explicitly adopts the exact output bytes through the Core Domain publication path.

elevation.value_semantics: Finite numeric elevation values over the declared Map Space.

unit.conversion: Unit conversion must be deterministic, versioned and captured in provenance/input fingerprints.

vertical_reference.identity: stable vertical_reference_id; do not infer from unit, CRS label or source filename.

spatial_contract.partial_coverage: allowed only when explicitly declared; uncovered cells must not be fabricated.

no_data.rules: No-data must never be interpreted as zero elevation, sea level, a sink or an outlet unless an explicit algorithm contract says so.

precision.coordinate_precision: Pinned by spatial.coordinate_precision_profile_id selected by the immutable Spatial Reference definition; this is coordinate quantization, not elevation sample encoding.
precision.sample_encoding: Physical sample encoding and quantization are pinned separately by value_encoding.profile_id and its immutable profile definition; do not infer float width or raster format from this descriptor.
precision.physical_encoding: Deferred to immutable field payload package contract; no production float width or quantization profile is selected by this registry.

land_water.value_semantics: Categorical land/water/unknown/outside-coverage mask over the declared Map Space.

categories.unknown: Within declared coverage, but land/water classification is unknown.
categories.outside_coverage: Explicit cell state outside the dataset's declared coverage; not equivalent to no-data.

no_data.rules: No-data is an absent/invalid sample, not a land/water class. Unknown and outside_coverage are explicit registered category states.

spatial_contract.partial_coverage: allowed only when explicit; outside_coverage must not be silently treated as water or coastline.

precision.physical_encoding: deferred to immutable field payload package contract.
precision.coordinate_precision: Pinned by spatial.coordinate_precision_profile_id selected by the immutable Spatial Reference definition.
precision.sample_encoding: Categorical sample representation is pinned separately by value_encoding.profile_id.

compatibility.breaking_semantics_change: Increment schema_version and semantics_id; invalidate dependent calculations and relevant Checkpoints.
compatibility.non_semantic_metadata_change: May preserve compatibility only when explicitly declared non-semantic and covered by validation.
compatibility.historical_selection: No historical Field Revision selection or Branch override in V1.
